d: Canada—a country home to the world's longest Great Trail; where the world-famous Niagara Falls are located, and where the Northern Lights and the Midnight Sun can be witnessed; Where the Bay of Fundy experiences the world's highest tides, and from where Santa Claus sends replies to children's letters—that is Canada. There is so much about this nation that you simply must discover. So, come join us on a journey to Canada, here on Infinity Stream.
